text.There was a receptionist and a security: Kulikuwa na mtu wa kupokea wageni na mlinzi pia, kwa hivyo kila mara kulikuwa na wafanyakazi wapatao 3 kwenye ghorofa ya chini. Concierge mmoja, mlinzi mmoja, na mfanyakazi mwingine mmoja.
text.Whenever you go out, you have to pass th: Kila unapotoka nje, lazima upite hapo, kwa hivyo unasalimia Concierge na mtu wa usalama kabla ya kutoka nje.
text.That turned out to be a habit we don't r: Hiyo iligeuka kuwa tabia ambayo hatuna kweli nyumbani.
text.A building with a concierge in Japan is,: Jengo lenye concierge huko Japan, nadhani, labda ni ghali sana.
text.Saying hello to someone every single day: Kusalimia mtu kila siku kabla ya kwenda nje. Nikikumbuka nyuma, nadhani tabia hiyo ilikuwa nzuri sana kwangu.
text.Step out of the building and there was a: Toka nje ya jengo na kulikuwa na nafasi kama bustani mbele, na wakati mwingine shule ya mpira wa miguu ilikuwa ikikimbia hapo.
text.Watching the kids playing football was f: Kutazama watoto wakicheza kandanda kulifurahisha pia.
text.Also, when you're on the ground floor, a: Pia, unapokuwa kwenye ghorofa ya chini, watu wa kila aina hupitia.
text.Sometimes I'd hear Japanese and realise,: Wakati mwingine ningesikia Kijapani na kugundua, lo, kulikuwa na Wajapani wanaoishi katika jengo hili pia.
text.In Cebu, my impression was that there we: Huko Cebu, maoni yangu yalikuwa kwamba kulikuwa na watu wa Magharibi zaidi.
text.Before that I lived on Luzon, the island: Kabla ya hapo niliishi Luzon, kisiwa cha Manila kinaendelea, na kulikuwa na watu zaidi kutoka Uchina, Taiwan na Korea. Sikusikia sana Kijapani huko.
text.Cebu felt like it had more Japanese peop: Cebu ilihisi kama ina watu wengi zaidi wa Japani.
text.You can also get to the pool from the gr: Unaweza pia kufika kwenye bwawa kutoka ghorofa ya chini.
text.The Philippines doesn't have Amazon. You: Ufilipino haina Amazon. Unanunua na programu zinazoitwa Lazada na Shopee, na concierge hupokea vifurushi kwa ajili yako.
text.For water, you didn't have to go out to: Kwa ajili ya maji, haukuhitaji kwenda kwenye duka la urahisi pia. Unaweza kuinunua kwa takriban 50 pesos galoni.
text.Living with a concierge downstairs was,: Kuishi na Concierge chini ilikuwa, niliendelea kufikiria, rahisi sana.
